messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick ask — can we iterate the battlecard quick-plays before Friday? Need: webinar hooks, benchmark narrative vs managed cloud endpoints, SDR rebut snippets for procurement.

Jordan (Product): Yep. Top 3 claims we should prioritize: unified runtime across hosted/ded/private; predictable economics via batching + KV cache; graceful degradation with model routing fallbacks. Need p95 numbers and cost deltas.

Mateo (Eng-ML): I'll pull the bench. Planning to compare redwood-v1 (quant) vs CloudX-managed-gpt and VendorY. Expect to see 30-50ms p95 advantage on small-chat patterns and 20-40% lower cost_per_1k_tokens after batching.

Mateo (Eng-ML): Benchmark run (local):
```
python bench.py --model redwood-v1 --seq 128 --qps 50 --compare cloudx-gpt
# outputs: p50,p95,cost_per_1k_tokens
```

Sam (Sales): For SDRs we need one-liners: latency, cost, security. Example: "Keeps latency predictable at scale — not a best-effort endpoint." Can someone make a tighter line for procurement?

Lila (Growth): Headline tests for webinar landing: A) "Inference that scales with SLAs, not surprises" B) "Control your inference economics" — I'll A/B test both. Also - short subheads: "Dedicated pools, private deploys, predictable spend."

Ava (Field): Rapid objection handling request: procurement will ask "why not just run on GCP/AWS endpoints?" Suggested reply: "Those are single-cloud managed endpoints. Redwood provides a serving runtime built for production LLMs — runtime optimizations (batching, KV caching), rollout controls, and private/VPC deployments with KMS integration so you get both performance and governance."

Jordan (Product): Add note to battlecard: rolling fallback examples (region fallback -> compatible quantized model -> degraded-mode with prefix cache) and how that maps to uptime/latency SLOs. Also call out SDK streaming + tool-calling support.

Priya (Marketing): Can someone draft 3 SDR snippets: one-line cost claim, one-line latency claim, one-line security/governance claim? Keep <25 words each.

Sam (Sales): Drafts: 1) Cost: "Cut per-token spend with smart batching and cache — measurable savings for high-QPS apps." 2) Latency: "Consistent p95s even under load — engineered for production SLAs." 3) Security: "Private control plane + KMS/HSM support for regulated data flows." :thumbsup:

Mateo (Eng-ML): Dropping raw CSVs + a short readme in Drive: https://drive.redwood/bench/3187 (placeholder link) — will add plots for p50/p95/cost curves.

Lila (Growth): Also consider webinar slot copy: call out real customer case (anonymized) where Dedicated cut tail latencies during peak by 40%. That stat converts.

Priya (Marketing): Good. Jordan, can you add the technical snippets (fallback flow, dedicated config) to the battlecard doc? Mateo — attach final bench figures. Lila — run headline A/B. Sam — prep SDR playbook with the 3 snippets + 2 rebut bullets per claim.

launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar draft deadline set for 2026-07-12 16:00 UTC :spiral_calendar_pad: (channel: #marketing)

Ava (Field): One more field ask: include a short demo script step for live webinar to show failover in action (3 slides + a quick terminal demo).

Priya (Marketing): Thanks team — I'll compile and share a new battlecard by EOD Friday and assign owners in the doc. If anyone can't hit their piece, ping me. :teamwork_smile:
